items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He was a banjo player and he told me he played clarinet when he was a little boy. I don't know. A very distinguished looking man.

ctx.x: Well, he was from New Orleans, you know. He was supposed to be a -- what do you call them? A Cajun or whatever, I don't know. We called him Henry Sapiro back then. Henri Sapiro or something like that. He was a banjo player and he told me he played clarinet when he was a little boy. I don't know. A very distinguished looking man. If you saw him you'd think he was I don't know what, you know, dressed very fine, and he had his hair all combed on the side. He was a big fellow and dressed beautiful, fine clothes and…
